title: Kyrie (Gombert, Missa Media Vita)
desc: Nicolas Gombert, Missa Media Vita, Kyrie. 5 voices (Superius, Altus I, Altus II, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
